tbesh_html:
Jabesh = "dry"
a town in the territory of Gilead; according to Eusebius, it is beyond the Jordan, 6 miles (10 km) from Pella, on the mountain road to Gerasa
may be modern 'Wadi Yabes'
Another name of ya.vesh (יָבֵשׁ "Jabesh" H3003GI)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Jobesh, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
strongs_1890.derivation: the same as H3002 (יָבֵשׁ) (also יָבֵישׁ; often with the addition of H1568 (גִּלְעָד), i.e. Jabesh of Gilad);
